claims.text: STIs: every state lets minors consent to STI testing and treatment without a parent.
claims.quote: All states and the District of Columbia allow minors to consent to sexually transmitted infection (STI) testing and treatment without parental permission

claims.text: Other minor-consent care: some states' consent laws also cover substance misuse treatment, pregnancy prevention and care, and sometimes abortion, mental health, and emergency care.
claims.quote: Other states have consent laws that include substance misuse treatment, pregnancy prevention and care, and, sometimes, abortion services, mental health care, and emergency care.

claims.text: Counseling: even where a parent must consent to contraception, you can still counsel the teen about her options.
claims.quote: that is, even when consent is required by a parent or guardian for provision of contraception, an obstetrician–gynecologist may still provide counseling about contraceptive options.

claims.text: Title X clinics: information about a client is confidential and is not disclosed without documented consent, except as needed for care or required by law.
claims.quote: All information as to personal facts and circumstances obtained by the project staff about individuals receiving services must be held confidential and must not be disclosed without the individual's documented consent, except as may be necessary to provide services to the patient or as required by law, with appropriate safeguards for confidentiality.

notes.issue: the source says "Other states", not "many", and the quote does not say to know your state's law
notes.resolution: claim reworded to the verifier's replacement text; the verifier passed that wording
